title: My Personal Portfolio
description: Built a responsive personal portfolio using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind, integrating OpenRouter AI models and custom image services, deployed on Vercel to showcase skills and attract client inquiries.

title: Hypatia Review Center Official Website

title: StudentTrack - Live map monitoring

title: Knyte and AI buddy of Pi Gamma Phi Gamma Sigma

description: Developed a responsive, SEO‑optimized website for the Pi Gamma Phi Gamma Sigma Capiz Chapter using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Vercel, and Neon DB, boosting member engagement and event visibility.
